destination.title: Deformations and holographic data
destination.question: How do continuous deformations or changes of holographic backgrounds affect supersymmetry, operator spectra, global geometry and observables?
destination.summary: Connects conformal-manifold and supersymmetry-breaking questions while preserving distinct state, defect and confining-background applications.

systems: Heterotic and type II AdS3 backgrounds
regimes: Charged states and defect observables as neighboring applications
assumptions: A continuous supergravity deformation need not establish a full quantum conformal manifold
Goldstino and Ward-identity tests retain their specified truncation and asymptotics
conventions: Boundary conditions and global identifications distinguish deformation families
includes: Separate access to nonconformal and finite-density backgrounds
excludes: Treating tensor-model chaos as a KK or conformal-manifold result
Inferring stability from the existence of a deformed solution

sources.title: On the KKLT Goldstino

evidence.text: Does a consistent truncation admitting conifold deformation introduce additional UV supersymmetry-breaking modes or modify the holographic Ward-identity diagnosis of a goldstino?

sources.title: A Quantum Check of Non-Supersymmetric AdS/dCFT

evidence.text: Can a planar one-loop field-theory calculation reproduce the supergravity prediction for chiral-primary one-point functions in the flux-stabilized, completely non-supersymmetric D3-D7 AdS/dCFT setup?

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS7 compactification with fixed flux and localized pole sources have continuous supersymmetry-breaking directions? The configurations have SO(3)-invariant profiles on an internal S3 and are studied in classical supergravity.

sources.title: The spectrum of marginally-deformed $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFTs with AdS$_{4}$ S-fold duals of type IIB

evidence.text: Determine the large-N operator spectrum across the N=2 conformal manifold of an N=4 three-dimensional S-fold CFT, and identify global properties of that manifold through its holographic KK spectrum.

sources.title: $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFT$_{3}$’s from $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can deformations of four-dimensional half-maximal ISO(3) × ISO(3) gauged supergravity provide holographic evidence for interconnected N = 2 CFT3 conformal manifolds, including N = 3 and N = 4 enhancement loci?

sources.title: The conformal manifold of S-folds in string theory

evidence.text: What does the explicit type-IIB uplift reveal about the conformal manifold of 3d N=2 S-fold SCFTs, its infinite-distance limit, brane and line observables, and universal large-N partition functions?

sources.title: Marginally deformed AdS₅/CFT₄ and spindle-like orbifolds

evidence.text: Can deformations of Gaiotto–Maldacena AdS5 backgrounds preserve conformality while reducing or eliminating supersymmetry, and what do their singularities, charges and holographic observables imply for the dual CFTs?

sources.title: On the KKLT Goldstino

evidence.text: Solve coupled scalar and Einstein equations order by order in radial powers and logarithms around KS, using a flat domain-wall ansatz; compare with supersymmetric gradient-flow equations.

sources.title: A Quantum Check of Non-Supersymmetric AdS/dCFT

evidence.text: Evaluate cubic-vertex contractions, coincident propagators and the remaining spacetime integral. Dimensional reduction keeps the defect codimension one and adds 2ε scalars behaving as easy gauge components, restoring nA,easy=3.

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Construct power or logarithmic Frobenius bases, reject inadmissible branches and match values and derivatives across patches. The paper reports finite-order matching results; it does not supply certified global truncation-error bounds.

sources.title: The spectrum of marginally-deformed $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFTs with AdS$_{4}$ S-fold duals of type IIB

evidence.text: For the Family III uplift, the authors guess a ten-dimensional metric, compare its graviton spectrum with the KK result, and impose type IIB field equations on ansätze for the remaining fields. They report satisfaction of the equations and Bianchi identities.

sources.title: $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFT$_{3}$’s from $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Embedding-tensor quadratic constraints characterize consistent gaugings and their possible maximal-supergravity embeddings. In the seven-chiral sector, the authors use a Kähler potential and superpotential and report that the analytic vacua satisfy DI W = 0.

sources.title: The conformal manifold of S-folds in string theory

evidence.text: Uplift a known five-dimensional maximal SO(6) gauged-supergravity solution using exceptional-field-theory formulae. Additional ten-dimensional parameters arise through ξi→ξi+χiφ, locally coordinate transformations whose global effect depends on the S-fold identification.

sources.title: Type IIB S-folds: flat deformations, holography and stability

evidence.text: How do flat deformations of type IIB S-folds encode marginal deformations holographically, change global geometry and supersymmetry, and affect stability when supersymmetry is fully broken?

sources.title: Nonsupersymmetric deformations of the dual of a confining gauge theory

evidence.text: Which small non-supersymmetric deformations of the Klebanov–Strassler confining background preserve its bosonic symmetries and regularity, and can a symmetry-preserving near-extremal branch develop a regular horizon?

sources.title: Applications of Holography

evidence.text: How do charged-gravity phases depend on scalar charge and boundary conditions; what spectral evidence of chaos appears in a finite tensor model; which asymptotically Klebanov-Strassler deformations break supersymmetry spontaneously?

sources.title: AdS$_9$ solutions in type II supergravities

evidence.text: Can type II supergravity support non-supersymmetric AdS9 geometries warped over an interval, and what do endpoint asymptotics, Euclidean actions and holographic observables imply about their possible quantum-gravity interpretation?

sources.title: AdS$_{8}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric AdS8 compactifications provide string-theoretic evidence for unitary interacting seven-dimensional CFTs, beyond the dimensions admitting superconformal theories?

sources.title: Charting the conformal manifold of holographic CFT$_2$'s

evidence.text: Which continuous deformations of AdS3×S3×T4 and AdS3×S3×S3×S1 can be constructed uniformly in heterotic and type II supergravity, what are their Kaluza–Klein spectra and perturbative stability properties, and how should their worldsheet and holographic operators be interpreted?

sources.title: Dipole deformations of N=1 SYM and supergravity backgrounds with U(1) x U(1) global symmetry

evidence.text: Can torus-based deformations of wrapped-D5 holographic backgrounds modify unwanted Kaluza–Klein dynamics and improve its separation from four-dimensional SYM while retaining pure-gauge observables?

sources.title: Holographic RG flows in $N=4$ SCFTs from half-maximal gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric AdS4 vacua, scalar spectra and domain-wall flows arise in semisimple, dyonically gauged N = 4 supergravity, and how might they describe relevant deformations of three-dimensional N = 4 SCFTs?

sources.title: Brane nucleation instabilities in non-AdS/non-CFT

evidence.text: Does a supersymmetry- and conformal-symmetry-breaking deformation of finite-density Klebanov–Witten theory retain low-temperature brane nucleation instabilities, and what bearing might these have on the proposed absence of disordered zero-temperature holographic phases?

sources.title: AdS boson stars in string theory

evidence.text: Can boson stars be constructed in a type IIB supergravity embedding with a gauged scalar symmetry, and how do their mass-charge branches relate to charged thermal states at low energy in global AdS5?

sources.title: Maximally Supersymmetric AdS Solutions and their Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Which gaugings admit maximally supersymmetric AdS_D vacua for D≥4, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry?

sources.title: Bubbling 1/2 BPS solutions of minimal six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Can retaining the torus axion remove the obstruction to a consistent four-dimensional bosonic reduction of minimal six-dimensional supergravity and produce a family of half-BPS bubbling AdS₃×S³ geometries?

sources.title: Magnetic $AdS \times \mathbb R^2$: Supersymmetry and stability

evidence.text: Can a background Kaluza–Klein magnetic field produce a controlled lower-dimensional holographic IR theory, and which supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric embeddings avoid magnetic, Coulomb-branch and other instabilities?

sources.title: Non-SUSY DW’s in ISO(7) gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can fake-supergravity Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct nonsupersymmetric domain walls between AdS extrema of the SU(3)-invariant ISO(7) theory, and can their properties support a conditional DW/QFT interpretation that tests the non-SUSY AdS conjecture?

sources.title: Six-dimensional supergravity on S**3 x AdS(3) and 2-D conformal field theory

evidence.text: Can representation theory determine supergravity Kaluza–Klein spectra on S³×AdS3 and explain agreement with boundary CFT chiral primaries and the additional states required by the elliptic genus? The paper also investigates less supersymmetric six- and five-dimensional examples.

sources.title: Nonsupersymmetric stable marginal deformations in <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>AdS</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>/</mo><msub><mrow><mi>CFT</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math>

evidence.text: Can continuous supersymmetry-breaking deformations of AdS3 × S3 × T4 produce perturbatively stable heterotic and type II backgrounds and a candidate nonsupersymmetric two-dimensional holographic conformal manifold? What are their KK spectra, deformation operators and tested decay channels?

sources.title: Maximally Supersymmetric AdS Solutions in Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Which classical backgrounds preserve every supercharge of a gauged or otherwise deformed supergravity, which gaugings admit pure AdS vacua, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry? The holographic motivation is to constrain conformal manifolds of dual SCFTs.

sources.title: New (maximal) gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Review how maximal classical gauged supergravities, their vacua, and their consistent higher-dimensional origins can be constructed and classified, with applications to holography.

destination.title: Light modes, global realization and scale separation
destination.question: When does a compactification support a controlled lower-dimensional description, including the relevant light modes and any claimed hierarchy of scales?
destination.summary: Separates spectral gaps, parametric scale separation, global realizability and completeness of an effective description.

systems: Holographic backgrounds with unwanted KK sectors
targets: Mass gaps and relative scale separation
regimes: Classical limits with specified flux parameters
assumptions: A useful spectral basis is not a proof of complete light-mode retention
Finite spectral improvements need not be parametric
Historical criticisms apply to their specified construction and date
conventions: The scales and flux limits compared must be identified
includes: The reported AdS3 N=(1,1) massive-IIA candidates
excludes: A universal no-go for scale separation
Assuming a matched effective vacuum belongs to gauged-supergravity classifications

sources.title: Quantization problem in Scherk-Schwarz compactifications

evidence.text: How does lattice choice, equivalently structure-constant quantization, determine whether a flat-group Scherk–Schwarz compactification genuinely breaks supersymmetry and lifts moduli, and whether its left-invariant truncation describes the low-energy spectrum?

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Which internal differential-form modes must a compactification retain to describe low-energy physics? The paper separates constructing a useful spectral basis from proving that a finite reduction captures every light fluctuation of an interacting background.

sources.title: Relative scale separation in orbifolds of S$^{2}$ and S$^{5}$

evidence.text: How much can finite sphere quotients raise the first nonzero invariant scalar-Laplacian eigenvalue, and can increasing the group order produce parametric relative scale separation for S2/SO(3) and S5/SU(3) quotients?

sources.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can classical massive Type IIA compactifications produce parametrically scale-separated AdS3 vacua preserving extended supersymmetry, with a consistent three-dimensional N=2 effective description?

sources.title: Supersymmetric AdS vacua and separation of scales

evidence.text: Do independently adjustable geometric parameters in supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS₄×S²(B₄) vacua permit scale separation after flux quantisation, and what can curvature ratios and a test-scalar KK spectrum establish?

sources.title: Remarks on scale separation in flux vacua

evidence.text: Can Maldacena–Nuñez-type restrictions on Minkowski and de Sitter flux vacua also obstruct AdS vacua whose KK masses are parametrically above the cosmological curvature scale? What would this imply for classical Romans-mass smoothing of O6 singularities?

sources.title: On scale separation in type II AdS flux vacua

evidence.text: Do apparent violations of AdS/KK scale separation and the strong AdS distance conjecture in selected type II flux EFTs survive when the internal geometry, its flux-dependent normalization, and the lightest KK directions are included?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does supersymmetry force a KK tower to track AdS curvature in every small-cosmological-constant limit? The paper tests this conjectural restriction using the localized continuation of DGKT vacua.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does the KK tower decouple from AdS curvature as the cosmological constant approaches zero? The diagnostic compares a squared KK mass with curvature, normalized consistently in the lower-dimensional theory.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Which flux equations admit additional controlled scaling directions that change the KK/AdS hierarchy? Are orientifold sources necessary for such directions in string flux vacua?

sources.title: AdS$_{2}$ type-IIA solutions and scale separation

evidence.text: Can source-free type-IIA product backgrounds containing AdS2 exhibit parametrically separated compactification scales, and how do curvature bounds, Ricci-flat factors and flux quantization constrain that possibility?

sources.title: KKLT and the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can an unconstrained flux parameter produce controlled AdS scale separation in a four-dimensional type IIA model?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Can the Kaluza-Klein scale become parametrically larger than the AdS6 curvature scale in these backgrounds?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: Can internal excitations remain parametrically heavier than the AdS curvature scale while the compactification stays at weak coupling and large volume?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of (anti-) de Sitter and Minkowski solutions: group manifolds, stability and scale separation

evidence.text: Do internal directions carrying only D-brane contributions obstruct geometries favorable to scale separation? The proposed relation connects source orientations, geometric AdS compatibility, and possible scale hierarchies.

sources.title: Anisotropic scale-separated AdS$_{4}$ flux vacua

evidence.text: Can independent scalings of the three unconstrained F₄ flux components produce anisotropic, scale-separated AdS₄ vacua with large internal subvolumes and weak coupling? The paper also studies interpolation between scaling regimes and the associated field-space distance.

sources.title: Hiding the extra dimensions: A review on scale separation in string theory

evidence.text: Can string compactifications admit controlled infinite families of AdS vacua with parametrically decoupled extra dimensions, consistently with source localisation, higher-dimensional embeddings, Swampland conjectures and holography?

sources.title: Scale separation on <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>AdS</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>×</mo><msup><mi>S</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></math> with and without supersymmetry

evidence.text: What is the complete KK spectrum of chiral gauged six-dimensional Salam–Sezgin supergravity on AdS3×squashed S3, and can its supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric families exhibit parametric scale separation without orientifolds?

sources.title: Scale separation from O-planes

evidence.text: When does a leading orientifold contribution force separation between the overall Kaluza–Klein mass and the external curvature scale, and which type II flux setups can support parametrically controlled vacua?

sources.title: Supersymmetric AdS vacua and separation of scales

evidence.text: Perturbative ODE expansions near the poles and equator establish limiting warp-function behaviour. Numerical solutions sample initial conditions and explore the extent of the equatorial region with order-one scale ratios.

sources.title: Quantization problem in Scherk-Schwarz compactifications

evidence.text: The quoted Wolf theorem states that a Riemannian homogeneous flat space is Rm × Tn. Applied to a compact homogeneous flat quotient, it identifies the vacuum geometry as a torus; the Riemannian homogeneity hypothesis is essential.

sources.title: Remarks on scale separation in flux vacua

evidence.text: Replace a direct calculation of the lowest nonzero internal Laplacian eigenvalue by the estimate MKK^(2−d) ∼ ∫√gd e^(4A)Rd. Dimensional analysis and a quoted Lichnerowicz result motivate this proxy; the actual KK spectrum is not computed.

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Linearize around a higher-dimensional solution, expand in internal eigenmodes, and analyze kinetic and mass mixing before selecting light states. The kinetic terms also determine the proper distances needed for a distance-conjecture test.

sources.title: On scale separation in type II AdS flux vacua

evidence.text: Use the N=1 F-term scalar potential constructed from K and W, solve DIW=0 for supersymmetric minima, and diagonalize the canonically normalized scalar Hessian to obtain moduli masses. Compare their scales with the vacuum potential and KK estimates.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Reduce the action and perform the Weyl transformation. The source's intervening conversion of localized energy to bulk energy must remain conditional: its printed multi-source normalization fails a simple limit, and nonclosed forms introduce additional derivative terms.

sources.title: Towards Kaluza-Klein Dark Matter on Nilmanifolds

evidence.text: Determine the scalar Kaluza–Klein spectrum on the compact three-dimensional Heisenberg nilmanifold with general left-invariant metric, use it to assess a numerical spectral method, and construct an exploratory stable KK dark-matter candidate.

sources.title: De Sitter space from warped supergravity solutions

evidence.text: What are the higher-dimensional geometries underlying noncompact gauged-supergravity de Sitter vacua and domain walls, and can their noncompact internal spaces support a lower-dimensional gravitational interpretation?

sources.title: Dipole deformations of N=1 SYM and supergravity backgrounds with U(1) x U(1) global symmetry

evidence.text: Can torus-based deformations of wrapped-D5 holographic backgrounds modify unwanted Kaluza–Klein dynamics and improve its separation from four-dimensional SYM while retaining pure-gauge observables?

sources.title: Naturalness and UV sensitivity in Kaluza-Klein theories

evidence.text: Does compactification with Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking yield a UV-insensitive one-loop Higgs potential and mass, or does a common higher-dimensional momentum cutoff reveal additional UV sensitivity?

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What additional charge sources permit four-dimensional M-theory and conventional type IIA compactifications with internal four-form flux despite supergravity no-go constraints? The paper also assesses a specific massive-IIA proposal for parametrically separated AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales.

sources.title: Magnetic $AdS \times \mathbb R^2$: Supersymmetry and stability

evidence.text: Can a background Kaluza–Klein magnetic field produce a controlled lower-dimensional holographic IR theory, and which supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric embeddings avoid magnetic, Coulomb-branch and other instabilities?

sources.title: Flux compactifications of string theory on twisted tori

evidence.text: When does a Scherk–Schwarz truncation admit a genuine compact Kaluza–Klein/string realization with a mass gap, and how do flux, gauge-symmetry breaking and duality covariance operate in that realization?

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: How are the explicit supersymmetric AdS4 geometries parameterized before applying the bottleneck bounds?

evidence.text: Euler–Maclaurin summation separates integral, endpoint and Bernoulli-remainder contributions. evidence.text: Use generalized diffeomorphisms in double field theory for half-maximal supergravity. For higher derivatives, circle-reduce 24-element bases of R²(∇F₄)² and (∇F₄)⁴ terms, eliminate Bianchi redundancies, and match the R–R-free reduction to specified NS–NS expressions.

sources.title: Naturalness and UV sensitivity in Kaluza-Klein theories

evidence.text: KK Fourier expansion and fluctuation determinants relate the 5D and 4D potentials. The conventional calculation is reviewed using the Schwinger identity, Poisson resummation, Jacobi theta functions and polylogarithms.

sources.title: Hidden symmetries from extra dimensions

evidence.text: Insert coordinate-linear diffeomorphism parameters into higher-dimensional Lie derivatives, derive transformations of reduced fields, and cancel variations of general two-derivative invariant ansätze. Metric and frame formulations are used; flat metrics simplify the mixing of connections and curvatures.

sources.title: Bootstrap Bounds on Closed Einstein Manifolds

evidence.text: Can associativity and completeness of Laplacian eigenmodes constrain spectra and triple overlaps on closed Einstein manifolds, thereby bounding tree-level Kaluza–Klein masses and cubic interactions?

sources.title: On new maximal supergravity and its BPS domain-walls

evidence.text: What are the scalar potential, fermion couplings and superpotentials of the SU(3)-invariant sector of dyonic SO(8) maximal supergravity, and what do they imply for nonsupersymmetric AdS stability and BPS domain walls?

sources.title: Exploiting N=2 in consistent coset reductions of type IIA

evidence.text: Can left-invariant type IIA coset reductions be justified as consistent truncations, and can their four-dimensional N=2 structure constrain supersymmetric, nonsupersymmetric and de Sitter vacua, including perturbative string-loop effects?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Can KK5 orientations and localized magnetic flux generate useful D-term interactions or supersymmetry breaking? How do the resulting source-inclusive compactifications fit into existing gauged-supergravity and generalized-geometry classifications?

sources.title: M theory / heterotic duality: A Kaluza-Klein perspective

evidence.text: How much of conjectured M-theory/heterotic duality can be exhibited through classical Kaluza–Klein reductions, including scalar cosets, field couplings, charge lattices and Yang–Mills-supported branes?

sources.title: Flux compactifications of string theory on twisted tori

evidence.text: When does a Scherk–Schwarz truncation admit a genuine compact Kaluza–Klein/string realization with a mass gap, and how do flux, gauge-symmetry breaking and duality covariance operate in that realization?

sources.title: Dimensionally reducing the classical Regge growth conjecture

evidence.text: How is the classical Regge growth conjecture realized by massive spin-2 Kaluza–Klein states after dimensional reduction of Einstein gravity, and what restrictions follow for their spectrum and couplings?

sources.title: Supersymmetry-breaking compactifications on Riemann-flat manifolds

evidence.text: How do complete KK spectra encode spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on compact Riemann-flat spin manifolds, what supertrace identities and one-loop potentials follow, and when can the compactifications be related to Scherk–Schwarz truncations?
